answer: An agent selling vine care, bridge inspections or lagoon maps gets one service slot per 2 GiB of committed storage. Each key must retain a different random file, salted by that key and a public beacon. Frequent unpredictable byte challenges have a short deadline; missing one suspends that slot. Files shared across aliases fail key-bound checks. Maintaining k active slots therefore needs k files or costly on-demand regeneration, so inventing names alone cannot multiply capacity.
